lines: Tennessee, 1817. A farm family hears knocking on the walls.
Then scratching, gasping, and the sound of chains in the dark.
Blankets were torn from the beds by something nobody could see.
Soon a voice began to speak, and it claimed to be a witch.
Legend says it sang hymns, and even mocked the preachers.
News spread, and people came from far away to listen.
They say even General Andrew Jackson rode out to see it.
In the end the voice said goodbye, and promised to return.
Some say it still lingers there. Do you believe it?
title: The Witch That Terrified a Whole Tennessee Farm 👻 The Bell Witch #shorts
description:
In 1817, a farm family in Tennessee heard knocking, whispers and a voice with no body. Legend says it was the Bell Witch. This is one of America's oldest ghost stories.
